decisions.reason: The label accurately conveys the number/quantity selected and is natural as a compact UI label.
Tiến lên correctly conveys moving/advancing forward in a short UI label.
The download-error message preserves the error, retry question, and newline structure naturally.

decisions.proposed_text: Quay về màn hình tiêu đề
decisions.reason: 返回标题 means returning to the title screen; the current Về tiêu đề is incomplete and sounds like returning to a title rather than the title screen.
Thử lại is the standard, accurate Vietnamese UI rendering of retry.
Chọn accurately renders the spaced source label 选 择 as a compact select action.
The current text literal-translates 支援卡 as Thẻ Hỗ trợ, which is explicitly forbidden by the embedded player-facing terminology rule.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community/source-bridge rules require 支援卡 to remain Support Card and forbid Thẻ hỗ trợ.

decisions.proposed_text: Không bao gồm phần mở khóa giới hạn
decisions.reason: The source explicitly refers to the portion/part excluded; adding phần preserves that structure and makes the Vietnamese grammatical.
持有数 is an owned quantity/count; Số lượng sở hữu is clearer and more natural than Số sở hữu.
拥有 is a static possession/owned label; Đang sở hữu unnecessarily adds progressive aspect.
Tổng cộng accurately and naturally renders the total label 共计.
Chi tiết is the standard and accurate UI rendering of 详情.
SSR is a rarity label/game token that should remain unchanged; source-equal-target is correct here.
Đồng ý accurately renders the agree/consent action 同意.
实际成绩 means actual result/performance; Điểm thành tích adds an unsupported notion of points.
Cấp độ accurately renders the generic level/grade label 等级.
Chất lượng accurately renders the generic quality label 品质.
The message preserves the need to download data, newline structure, MB unit, and the {0:0.00} runtime placeholder with natural Vietnamese wording.
外部连接确认 is an external-link confirmation label; kết nối ngoài reads more like a network/external connection and is less precise in this UI context.
Độ thân thiết accurately conveys the generic intimacy/closeness measure 亲密度, with no embedded canonical rule requiring a different label.
